gitStatus.tooltip.no-git: You can keep designing without Git history. Git is needed to publish or connect GitHub.
gitStatus.failure.no-changes.nextStep: Make a change in this Project, then try Create PR again.
gitStatus.failure.push-refused.nextStep: Ask the agent to check repository access and branch rules, then try Create PR again.
gitStatus.failure.org-approval.nextStep: Authorize GitHub CLI with SSO or ask an admin for access, then try Create PR.
gitStatus.failure.sign-in.nextStep: Ask the agent to help you sign in to GitHub CLI, then try Create PR again.
gitStatus.failure.unknown.nextStep: Check Project Chat for details, then ask the agent to try Create PR again.
gitStatus.queued.label: Queued
gitStatus.queued.hint: Runs when the agent finishes this turn
gitStatus.noAccessLine: {repo} · no access for @{account} · ask an owner
gitStatus.prompt.create-pr: Open a pull request for this branch against {base}.
gitStatus.prompt.upload-changes: Commit and push my changes to the pull request.
gitStatus.prompt.fix-checks: The checks on this pull request fail. Read the failures and fix them.
gitStatus.prompt.resolve-conflicts: This branch has conflicts with {base}. Update from {base} and resolve them.
gitStatus.prompt.connect-github: Sign me in to GitHub with the gh CLI. If gh is not installed, walk me through installing it first. Then run `gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web` — it prints a one-time code and a URL; tell me both so I can finish in my browser, then confirm with `gh auth status`.
